title: Incident & Breach Management
rationale: Closes the loop between Security Ops and Compliance. Risks predict what could happen; incidents track what did happen. This connects incidents to obligations, controls, and regulatory reporting — the full lifecycle. Extends existing Risk Management and integrates with Obligation Management (PRD-009) and Findings (PRD-007).

user_stories.story: As a Security Analyst, I want to log an incident with category, severity, and affected systems, so that the compliance team has immediate visibility.
acceptance_criteria: User can create an incident with title, description, category, severity.
Incident is linked to impacted controls and risks.

user_stories.story: As a Compliance Officer, when an incident is logged, I want the system to automatically identify triggered regulatory obligations (e.g., GDPR 72h breach notification), so that I know exactly what we must report and when.
acceptance_criteria: System matches incident category to conditional obligations.
Countdown timer starts for time-sensitive obligations.
Dashboard shows all triggered obligations with deadlines.

user_stories.story: As a Compliance Officer, I want to generate a post-incident report that includes timeline, root cause, impact, and corrective actions, so that I can satisfy regulatory reporting requirements.
acceptance_criteria: System provides a report template pre-filled with incident data.
Report includes linked controls, obligations triggered, and remediation actions.

user_stories.story: As a Risk Manager, I want incidents to automatically create Findings (PRD-007), so that corrective actions are tracked to closure.
acceptance_criteria: When an incident is closed, a Finding is auto-created for each root cause.
Finding links back to the originating incident.

user_stories.story: As a Compliance Manager, I want a 'Lessons Learned' repository linked to incidents, so that the organization can improve over time.
acceptance_criteria: Each closed incident can have a 'Lessons Learned' entry.
Lessons can be linked to updated controls or policies.

new_models: Incident (title, description, category, severity, status, reported_by, resolved_at)
